results.note: Kremlin item "Meeting with US President Donald Trump" (19 Nov, Shenzhen): after the APEC plenary Putin met Trump with delegations (Lavrov, Siluanov, Ushakov, Dmitriev; Rubio, Bessent), separately from the later three-way meeting.

Xinhua via People's Daily, 19 Nov: the meeting chaired by Xi "adopted by consensus the 2026 APEC Leaders' Declaration" (Shenzhen Outlook) plus three outcome documents; apec.org had not yet listed it when read.

The three-way meeting took place on 19 Nov and the joint "Declaration toward Peace" says "the three countries will conduct a dialogue on reducing nuclear risks and preventing the proliferation of nuclear weapons", which we read as an agreed trilateral follow-up on nuclear arms control/strategic stability rather than vague "maintain communication" wording (interpreted).

The ICJ judgment of 19 Nov (case 178) found that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya (9 votes to 6), a breach of the Genocide Convention; ICJ PDFs refuse scripted reading, so confirmed by Al Jazeera/AFP/Reuters and the Wikipedia case entry quoting the finding.

Al Jazeera (with AFP and Reuters): the Court ruled on 19 Nov that Myanmar had committed genocide, nine judges to six, the first such finding against a state; Wikipedia quotes the finding that Myanmar "committed acts falling under ... the genocide convention with an intent to destroy" the Rohingya.
ČTK, 19 Nov: at the resumed constituent session the assembly elected Petr Hlaváček (STAN) mayor of Prague, replacing Bohuslav Svoboda.
ČTK gives no vote count but names only two opposition members (Hušbauer and Nepil, ANO) who voted for Hlaváček, so his total was at most 47 + 2 = 49, below 50 (inferred; no assembly record readable).
ČTK, 19 Nov: Ladislav Václavec (for ANO) was re-elected Senate vice-president with 63 votes.
ČTK, 19 Nov: Vystrčil was elected Senate President for the fifth time, unopposed, with 69 of 77 votes cast (seven more than in 2024).

The Berlin joint statement and Burnham's speech name air defence, 1,000 UK drones, a UK £10bn package and the EU's existing €90bn Ukraine Support Loan, but no collective amount for military support in 2027; we did not count the EU loan, an existing 2026-27 EU instrument for budget and military needs (interpreted).
AP, 19 Nov: Walmart now projects full-year EPS of $2.84 to $2.89 (from $2.80-2.87), midpoint $2.865, above $2.835; Walmart's own release was not read.
Senate roll call 270 on 19 Nov: H.R. 2347, as amended, passed 62-33.
Cenový věstník částka 127 of 19 Nov 2026 sets the maximum diesel price for 20 Nov at 45,20 Kč s DPH per litre (petrol 39,80).
ČTK, 19 Nov: Babiš said after the cabinet meeting that the government did not take up extending fuel-price regulation beyond November because Finance Minister Schillerová was away in Brno.
BusinessTech, 19 Nov: the SARB MPC kept the repo rate at 7.25%, four members for the hold and three for a 25 bp hike.
AP, 19 Nov 13:33 UTC: the Labor Department said initial jobless claims rose to 203,000 for the week (from a revised 202,000); dol.gov PDF not machine-readable from the run.
